shortBio.en: Session wizard turned architect of Led Zeppelin's guitar mythology.
shortBio.zh: 录音室鬼才，Led Zeppelin 吉他神话的架构者。

whyHub.en: Yardbirds unfinished business → Led Zeppelin weather system.
whyHub.zh: Yardbirds 没做完的事 → Led Zeppelin 天气系统。

body.en: Page is a hub because his career shows how rock personnel flow: studio player → Yardbirds → a new band that redefines Hard Rock. Follow his tenures to see why lineup 'versions' matter more than endless churn logs.
body.zh: Page 是枢纽，因为他的履历展示摇滚人事流动：录音室乐手 → Yardbirds → 一支重写 Hard Rock 的新乐队。跟着 tenure 看，就会明白为何阵容「版本」比流水账换人更重要。

note.en: Beck's exit, Page inherits the lab.
note.zh: Beck 离开，Page 接手实验室。
